procedural_matters: ITA 221118 was represented by Dimitri Peroni.
The race committee was represented by Christina Buch (course race officer).
Enrico Strazzer (coach of ITA 221118) attended the hearing as an observer.
Matteo Bertacchi (ITA 216995) gave evidence as a witness.
Bennet Rabsch (pin-end boat) gave evidence as a witness.
facts: During the second attempt to start race 2 for the yellow fleet, the conditions were 5-8 knots of wind with strong current pushing the boats over the starting line.
The race committee displayed the black flag as preparatory signal.
The race committee did not move the pin-end mark after the preparatory signal.
ITA 221118 was starting near the middle of the starting line.
The race committee identified ITA 221118 in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before the starting signal.
The race committee signalled a general recall after the starting signal and displayed the sail number of ITA 221118 on the race committee signal vessel before the next warning signal.
ITA 221118 did not sail in race 2 and was scored BFD.
conclusions: There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
